global:
# operator note: keep this comment
[review]
max_rounds = 2

[accounts]
auto_switch = true

[[accounts.records]]
id = "work"
name = "work"
harness = "claude"
auth = "oauth_dir"
credentials_source = "{TMP}/creds"
priority = 10

[[accounts.records]]
id = "makers"
name = "makers"
harness = "claude"
auth = "oauth_dir"
credentials_source = "{TMP}/creds"
priority = 20

[[accounts.records]]
id = "cx"
name = "cx"
harness = "codex"
auth = "oauth_dir"
credentials_source = "{TMP}/creds"
priority = 30

[accounts.combos.daily]
strategy = "round_robin"
sticky_limit = 3
providers = ["work", "makers"]

[accounts.combos.spare]
strategy = "fallback"
sticky_limit = 1
providers = ["cx"]

expect.stderr: error: Combo 'spare' has invalid strategy 'nope'; valid: ('fallback', 'round_robin')
